description: Updates civic naming policy to prioritize underrepresented groups.
Adds processes for secondary names, signage, and name removal.
Recommends annual public engagement for new name submissions.

chips.text: The development community is affected by new name pre-assignment at concept plan stage.
Development community generally supported policy changes, preferring limited engagement due to cost.
Councillor Kelsie Parker opposed a motion to review committee composition
Policy aims to increase representation of women, Indigenous people, and newcomers in civic names.
Administration will provide a memo in December to clarify the naming policy process for Council.
